description: Adds a plugin to a site (paid plans): kind and settings shaped as list_plugins settings_help (forms: the typed forms field, or form_html). Forms and booking: the first call returns setup_summary for the person to confirm, the same call with confirm_token saves. Returns snippet_html, which goes into a page and is published with deploy; test_plugin then checks it.

confirm_token.description: From the first call, after the user's yes

form_html.description: Forms: the page's <form>; declares the fields

forms.description: Typed settings for a forms plugin (implies kind forms)

kind.description: Which plugin (forms is implied by forms)

lang.description: The <html lang> of the page the snippet goes on (e.g. de): snippet_html then speaks it. One snippet per language on a multilingual site

name.description: A name for the owner, e.g. "Contact form"

settings.description: Shaped as list_plugins settings_help for the kind (booking too)

name: add_plugin
title: Add a plugin
